description: Graph Workflow — state write validation hook (Qoder). Same node script as the ZCode variant (hooks.zcode.json). install-qoder.js copies this file to hooks/hooks.json in the install dir, where Qoder auto-discovers it (wrapper format, per https://docs.qoder.com/zh/cli/plugins). ${QODER_PLUGIN_ROOT} is injected as env var (bash) or pre-substituted (PowerShell); timeout unit is seconds; exit 2 + stderr blocks.
